name: ARL Linter (CIR v2)
description: 5-pass CIR-SDM structural linter orchestrator: classification, authority (I7), lattice (I8), invariants (I1-I3), and governance dependency graph (B2)
notes: CIR v2 governance enforcement — runs 5 invariant passes

name: CIR-1 Scan
description: Builds a reference index of CIR-relevant patterns (intent_source, PIPELINE_, work_request, etc.) across the repository using ripgrep

name: CIR Ontology Lint Engine
description: Combined structural invariant gate for configuration ontology integrity. Implements CIR-1 through CIR-5 with CIR-SDM
health: exit code 0 = pass, 1 = violations in strict mode
notes: Phantom references, cross-layer leaks, implicit semantics, derived state, canonical authority

name: CIR Deterministic Patch Engine
description: Patches CIR violations deterministically. Removes phantom references, quarantines cross-layer leaks, missing contracts, etc.
notes: CIR-1 auto-removes; CIR-2/3/4/5 wrap in quarantine markers

name: CCNF Conformance CLI
description: Go-based CCNF conformance tool that runs golden vector suites, validates event files, hashes events, and canonicalizes JSON

name: PGV (Packaging Governance Verifier)
description: Packaging Governance Verifier that extracts package dependency graphs, validates import rules (P6-P10), detects cycles and backflow violations
invocation: go run tools/pgv/ [validate] | go run tools/pgv/ diff <base> <head>
health: validate mode checks package governance invariants

name: CCNF Verifier (Rust)
description: Independent Rust CCNF contract evaluator. Validates CCNF pipeline output against Go golden vectors (R8), runtime boundary (R9), replay (R10)
notes: Cross-language hash verification against Go golden vectors

name: Harvest Pipeline (Rover)
description: Ingests HTML chat transcripts via Dockling, extracts candidates via LLM, promotes to intent_records

name: Converse CLI
description: CLI for the agentic pipeline. Captures ideas as events, shows status, advances workflows, and manages step approvals/rejections
health: subcommands: capture, status, next, request, approve, reject, clean

name: Conduit Temporal Worker
description: Temporal Worker for Conduit agent orchestration. Polls Temporal task queues and executes Activities/Workflows

name: Conduit Temporal Scheduler
description: Scans for eligible plans and starts PlanExecutionWorkflows on Temporal task queues
health: scans for eligible plans at configurable interval

name: Model Registration Tool
description: Deterministic model registration: reads opencode config and registers all models from a provider as pipeline model entries

name: Voyager Filesystem Scanner
description: Filesystem Acquisition Layer that scans directories, deduplicates via Redis, and publishes file events to NATS

name: Documentation Generator
description: Scans a Python directory and generates Markdown API reference documentation from AST analysis

name: ADR-001 Governance Guardrail
description: Enforces ADR-001/ADR-002 IR Identity Governance: golden rebaseline checks, structural change guards, phase lock, and phase authority validation

name: CEGL-A Verification Engine
description: CEGL-A detection layer that validates evolution legality. Runs state compiler, checks transitions, reports entropy costs

name: Agent Chat Server
description: Async agent chat server for the message box. Accepts @agent messages, dispatches to opencode, and streams responses via SSE

name: Nebula Reseeder
description: Scans the nexus filesystem and populates Nebula RMS with all projects that have documentation via the nebula-srv API
health: populates Nebula RMS from filesystem docs

name: Service Registry Migration Tool
description: Reads service-registry JSON config files and inserts them directly into the PostgreSQL registry schema
